newsitem.title: ITALY: HORSE RACING-SHANTOU GIVES EPSOM TRAINER WIN IN MILAN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SHANTOU GIVES EPSOM TRAINER WIN IN MILAN.

text.p: Shantou won the Gran Premio di Milano at San Siro on Sunday, giving trainer John Gosden further glory after his Epsom Derby win with Benny the Dip eight days ago.
In an all-British finish, St Leger winner Shantou, ridden by Frankie Dettori, pushed Clive Brittain's Luso and John Dunlop's Taipan into second and third places.
It was Shantou's second big win at the course after his success in the Gran Premio del Jockey Club e Coppa d'Oro last October.
Strategic Choice, last year's winner, took the lead after half a mile but gradually gave way as Luso and odds-on favourite Shantou battled from two furlongs out.
Shantou asserted his authority at the end to win by a length and a quarter from Luso, who had to settle for second place for the second year in a row.
Taipan, initially outpaced, raced on strongly at the finish to take third a further half length back.
Strategic Choice, unable to raise his game when it mattered most, was beaten a little under three lengths into fourth.
Toto Le Moko, the only home runner, and Needle Gun completed the finishing order but were well beaten in fifth and sixth positions.
